title: Preserve the FT-016 browser-capture redaction handoff
verify: Independent source and dependency inspection proves FT-015 adds no frontend or browser-capture path and FT-016 directly retains both Product Surface Redaction and the protected photo-storage status contract.
evidence_required: FT-015-AC-011 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the current brownfield tree has no Operator PWA or screenshot/browser-capture implementation, so runtime capture behavior cannot be invoked without implementing FT-016; alternative proof: source/dependency absence plus exact FT-016 canonical links to Product Surface Redaction and Photo Intake storage status; decisive comparison: no FT-015 frontend/capture owner and durable FT-016 handoff present; artifact: static scope report under .tasks/TASK-072-T2-FT-015-W1/.
purpose: Keep the absent browser-capture surface out of FT-015 while making its future FT-016 security and storage-status inputs independently verifiable.
success_outcome: FT-015 contains no frontend or browser-capture implementation, and FT-016 directly consumes Product Surface Redaction plus the protected photo-storage status contract without gaining backend storage or sync authority.
anti_goals: Do not create Svelte/SvelteKit code, screenshot tooling, a placeholder frontend, browser storage, prompt rendering, or capture tests before FT-016.
Do not move photo accounting, prompt state, authorization, upload, or sync authority into FT-016.
constraints: Use source/dependency inspection and canonical links only; no absent runtime is fabricated.
Preserve FT-016 as the sole presentation/capture owner.
invariants: FT-015 creates no competing frontend or capture surface.
A future browser capture must sanitize or omit forbidden values before capture.
Operator PWA never owns backend storage or sync state.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-011: current capture non-applicability plus exact FT-016 redaction/status consumer links and no FT-015 frontend scope.

forbidden_scope: Frontend/Svelte/PWA implementation, screenshot tooling, backend storage/status behavior, prompt persistence, upload/server/sync lifecycle, or historical evidence.
stop_conditions: A current browser-capture implementation is discovered.
FT-016 cannot retain the canonical inputs without changing accepted ownership.
